requirements.source: I am trapped inside a dangerous automated factory.
requirements.meaning: Visual industrial factory theme for the platformer environment
requirements.verification: Factory visual theme applied to platforms and background

requirements.source: To escape, I must activate TWO separate switches located in different parts of the level.
requirements.meaning: Two switches must be activated to progress
requirements.verification: Both switches must be toggled to open the gate

requirements.source: The first switch activates moving platforms that let me cross a dangerous machinery pit.
requirements.meaning: Moving platforms span across pits when activated by the first switch
requirements.verification: Moving platforms appear or activate upon triggering switch 1

requirements.source: Add patrolling robot guards and environmental hazards, but keep combat optional. I should be able to avoid enemies instead of fighting them.
requirements.meaning: Patrolling enemy guards roam the platforms
requirements.verification: Enemies patrol back and forth on platforms, avoidable without combat

scope: Structured construction witnesses plus specific runtime checks; visual style needs human review.
